title: Pin the publish job's npm exactly (release.yml: npm install -g npm@^11 is a range)
description: release.yml publish job (the only job with id-token: write) installs npm@^11, a range, to meet the OIDC trusted-publishing floor. DEC-240 (a5) pins an exact npm 12 on the six package-qualification hosts; the publish job was left unchanged in opum-ai/lore-cli#685 by the leader's ruling and needs its own exact pin (and a decision on whether it moves to 12). Found while building LCLI-768. Not a release blocker for #685; the release stays held (LCLI-751).
